tasks.label: Build: Simulator Full
tasks.command: rm -rf build && cmake -B build -DPLATFORM_NAME=Simulator && cmake --build build -j4

tasks.label: Build: Simulator Incremental
tasks.command: if [ -d build ] && grep -q 'Simulator' build/CMakeCache.txt 2>/dev/null; then cmake --build build -j4; else rm -rf build && cmake -B build -DPLATFORM_NAME=Simulator && cmake --build build -j4; fi

tasks.label: Build: RP2040 Full
tasks.command: rm -rf build && cmake -B build -DPLATFORM_NAME=RP2040 && cmake --build build -j4

tasks.label: Build: Incremental
tasks.command: cd build && if [ -f build.ninja ]; then source ~/esp-idf/export.sh 2>/dev/null && ninja; else make -j4; fi
